application:authorization-model:accounts.decision: Email-and-password accounts with server-side sessions in http-only cookies; roles customer and staff; staff manage slots, customers manage only their own bookings and waitlist entries.

application:business-rule:cancellation-r.decision: Full refund through Stripe on every allowed cancellation; cancellations under 24h stay refused. Booking becomes status 'cancelled' (not deleted) with the refund id recorded.

application:business-rule:recurring-paym.decision: Charge each occurrence up front at series creation (one Stripe charge per occurrence with its own idempotency key); if any charge fails, refund the ones that succeeded and create nothing. Keeps A's pay-at-booking rule and makes per-occurrence refunds simple. Saved-card charging is deferred (needs stored payment methods and off-session consent).

application:workflow:waitlist-release.decision: Cancellation emits slot-freed; the first waiting customer gets an offer and an exclusive hold (2 hours, ending no later than 24h before start); accepting runs the normal booking and payment flow; expiry passes the offer to the next. No automatic charges.

database:manual:slot-double-booking.decision: A partial unique index on bookings(slot_id) where status in (held, confirmed); create the booking as 'held' inside a transaction, charge, then confirm; on payment failure delete the hold.

application:workflow:recurring-cancellat.decision: Per-occurrence 24h rule; 'cancel series' cancels all remaining occurrences 24h+ away and refunds each.

application:workflow:recurring-partial-a.decision: All-or-nothing, listing the taken weeks so the customer can shorten the series or join their waiting lists.

database:duplicate-entity:booking.decision: Merge A:Booking and B:Booking into one Booking entity (A's user_id, slot_id, created_at plus status, series_id for recurring, payment and refund ids); field origins listed in architecture.json

database:duplicate-entity:slot.decision: Merge into one Slot entity (A's starts_at and price, plus ends_at, published_by, status); A's 'taken' flag replaced by the unique active-booking constraint

migration:booking.decision: PLAN ONLY (high risk, destructive once architecture fixed types): if BookNow data exists, map A user_id/slot_id (unknown types) to uuid via a lookup table keeping the old id in legacy_id; B has no data to migrate (closed product). Backup, dry run, checks and rollback in design/migration-plan.md. Nothing runs without a separate run approval.

migration:slot.decision: PLAN ONLY (high risk): A price (unknown type) converted to integer minor units with a dry-run check that every value converts exactly; A taken flag not stored, derived from active bookings, and the dry run verifies every taken=true slot has a booking. See design/migration-plan.md.

migration:waitlistentry.decision: No source data exists (B is closed); table created empty
